subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should this performance-audit branch stop after the failed first extraction, or should ClawHub sponsor one new bounded route-entry hypothesis for measurement?
rationale: The evidence rejects the proposed extraction but cannot establish which remaining cross-route contract is worth refactoring; choosing the next target trades architectural churn against a performance objective and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Stop after the no-go
options.body: Treat the reverted experiment and measurements as the completed outcome for this narrow audit branch, leaving broader performance work under the umbrella.

options.title: Sponsor one new hypothesis
options.body: Name one route-contract boundary and a concrete closure-reduction target, then require manifest and cold-navigation evidence before expanding the refactor.

recommendation.title: Stop after the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the reverted experiment and measurements as the completed outcome for this narrow audit branch, leaving broader performance work under the umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the controlled measurements and have merged adjacent route-performance work, making them the best available routing candidate for the evidence and next hypothesis.
